'''2011 Minnesota State Championship Joe Getz LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Getz]] at [[2011 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' WYS
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
